If the raw value for a vocabulary-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      # sex has a vocabulary type (sex_types) and so requires a string value.
      sex: false

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.sex: value discarded: expected string for "sex_types" vocabulary lookup, got bool
persons\[someone\].Properties.sex: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[someone\].Properties.sex: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties: {}
